description: packageRules, go.yaml.in/yaml/v3: no major update. The kyaml formatter looks for an alias inside its own anchor's node with the parser sigs.k8s.io/yaml/kyaml reads with, which is yaml/v3, so that the check and the encoder see the same aliases; read with v4, the two could disagree on what a document holds. Drop this rule when kyaml reads with v4 itself.
